qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Exclusive state-granted franchise monopoly across Wisconsin, Illinois, Michigan, and Minnesota. Physical electric wires and natural gas pipelines are legally and economically impossible to duplicate. Formulaic rate-base pricing power allows pass-through of fuel and operating costs with allowed return on equity (~9.8%).
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (Balance sheet debt/NI = 11.9x > 4.0x, EBIT/interest = 2.5x < 5.0x, REJECT). Exemplary regulated utility franchise with premier management, but structurally burdened by massive capital intensity (capex 3x D&A), legally capped ROIC (6.3%), and $18.5B debt requiring perpetual access to debt capital markets.
qualitative.evidence: 10-year median GAAP ROIC is 6.34% (tangible ROIC 7.4%). TTM LT debt of $18.50B against net income of $1.56B yields 11.9x debt-to-earnings leverage, far above the 4.0x threshold. TTM EBIT of $2.24B covers interest of $895M at just 2.51x (below 5.0x minimum). TTM capex of $4.40B exceeds D&A ($1.48B) by nearly 3x, creating persistent negative free cash flow after total capex funded by ongoing debt issuances.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
